work_title: Take into account dataInputs during mempool updateFamily (#1156)
description: Completed in https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2940 (targeting v6.0.11): updated OrderedTxPool.updateFamily to propagate transaction weight to unconfirmed parent transactions referenced via tx.dataInputs in addition to tx.inputs while preserving Set[WeightedTxId] deduplication, and added unit tests in ErgoMemPoolSpec.
